recognize_zh: 淋巴結副皮質區可見淡染的組織球／蘭格漢斯細胞（核細長、有核溝、細胞質淡粉紅）與小淋巴球混雜，其中散佈含棕色顆粒狀黑色素（melanin）的巨噬細胞，這種組合就是皮膚病變引流淋巴結的皮膚病性變化（dermatopathic change）。
features: Paracortical expansion by pale histiocytes and interdigitating dendritic/Langerhans-type cells with elongated, folded or grooved nuclei and abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
Scattered macrophages containing coarse brown granular pigment consistent with melanin
Admixed small mature lymphocytes forming a mottled pattern
Prominent high endothelial venules within the paracortex
No atypical lymphoid cells or cerebriform nuclei evident at this magnification
describe_en: Section of lymph node shows paracortical expansion by a mixture of pale-staining histiocytes and dendritic cells with elongated, folded to grooved nuclei and abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm, admixed with small mature lymphocytes and high endothelial venules. Numerous scattered macrophages contain coarse brown granular pigment consistent with melanin. No cytologically atypical lymphoid population is identified in this field. Findings are consistent with dermatopathic lymphadenopathy, a reactive change in nodes draining chronic skin conditions; in patients with erythroderma, early involvement by mycosis fungoides should be excluded with T-cell markers and clonality studies.

ddx.dx: Lymph node involvement by mycosis fungoides/Sézary syndrome
ddx.vs: MF involvement shows clusters or sheets of atypical cerebriform lymphocytes with loss of T-cell antigens and a clonal TCR rearrangement rather than only benign small lymphocytes.
LCH shows sinusoidal sheets of Langerhans cells with frequent eosinophils and eosinophilic microabscesses, not a mottled paracortical pattern with melanin-laden macrophages.
Melanoma forms cohesive nests of atypical cells with prominent nucleoli and SOX10/HMB45 positivity, while here pigment is within bland macrophages.
Hemosiderin is golden-brown and refractile and stains with Prussian blue, whereas melanin is finer, darker brown and Fontana-Masson positive.
